summary: Frontend-only regression on WhiteFox after focus-return, reset-dialog, lock-store and CSS fixes. All target specs pass on the production build served by supervisor. Run tests directly: cd /app && APP_URL=http://localhost:3000 APP_PASSWORD='<APP_PASSWORD>' ADMIN_LOGIN=admin npx playwright test tests/e2e/<spec>. Targeted specs 46 (4 tests, ~1.7m), 45 (3), 44 (4), 99 (10), 12 (1) all green in iter47. Known pre-existing (out-of-scope) failures per E1 note: 06-storage-migration.spec.ts:107, 14/15-bulk-*, 21-mcp-external — not related to focus-return/reset/CSS changes.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — iter45 P1 bugs (reset accepts 'СБРОСИТЬ\n' and uploaded file lost after reset) are confirmed fixed: 45-P1 now green (strict confirm variants + file-key map cleared + login unchanged).
